# Conduit Context — Simple Guide

A minimal onboarding flow: one stage that gathers business details from a new
customer and verifies them.

## Bindings

This guide defines no value slots; the single `process-info` task receives its
input from the operator interaction on the Onboarding pane.

## Reading retrieved prose

Retrieved excerpts describe the onboarding scope (audience, goals, boundaries,
tone). Treat them as ground rules for the interaction, not as content to echo
back to the customer.
